mentions.claim_text: He recounts meetings in Fort Worth, Texas where the building appeared to be on fire and the fire department attended to find no fire, saying it was on fire with the Holy Ghost and visible in the spirit realm, and introduces what the Lord said he is about to do.
mentions.quote: the building looked like it was on fire and the fire department came
mentions.falsify_match: A fire department call-out to a church with no fire found, which would leave a public record.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such call-out. Recounted as history rather than forecast, and the story is a standing item in revival folklore about the Azusa Street and Smith Wigglesworth meetings.

mentions.claim_text: He says that last year the Lord told them they had delayed the financial crash and crisis for a four-year window, correcting himself from three to four, and that they had delayed things.
mentions.quote: you've delayed the financial crash crisis for this four-year window
mentions.falsify_match: A financial crash arriving at the end of the four-year window rather than before it.
mentions.falsify_miss: A crash inside the window, or none at all. Note the delay is claimed for an event that had not been dated in the first place.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees China highlighted and Europe, that it is about control and is like an act of war and a retaliation, and reports the Lord saying to remember Red Dawn.
mentions.quote: The Lord says, Remember these Red Dawn
mentions.falsify_match: A Chinese action against the West identifiable as an act of war.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Red Dawn is recalled rather than newly given.

mentions.claim_text: He says a sliver has been given and Adam's lease is coming up, that things are falling in line like dominoes around the UN, and that he sees people dying by the millions bent over with the virus.
mentions.quote: I see them dying by the millions. I see them bent over with this virus
mentions.falsify_match: Mass deaths from a respiratory illness on the scale described.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Undated, and the deaths are tied to Adam's lease, which has no public marker.

mentions.claim_text: He says the weather he told them was coming is here, calls it weather warfare, and says he saw weapons of weather warfare while noting others call it seeding.
mentions.quote: I saw weapons of weather warfare
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence of deliberate weather modification used as a weapon.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Cloud seeding exists and is public, but it cannot produce the events he attributes to it.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told to remember the moon and to watch the moon around the 10th, calling the full moon a significant time frame in the spirit realm, in the context of attempts to create superhumans.
mentions.falsify_match: A significant event on or about 10 July 2025 connected to the moon.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing. The full moon fell on 10 July 2025 and is a published date, so naming it required a calendar.

mentions.claim_text: He says decisions are being made but are not set in stone, that the framework and foundation of them are coming to the table as he speaks, and that this is what to pray about.
mentions.quote: These decisions are not set in stone yet
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: no decision, party or subject is named.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is praying over the peace agreement and the covenant of many with the Arab nations, and that he saw the Arab nations agreeing to a peace accord with Israel under which a third temple can be built in exchange for giving up land.
mentions.quote: A third temple can be built, but you have to give so much land
mentions.falsify_match: An Arab-Israeli accord trading land for permission to build a temple.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such accord. The land-for-temple exchange is a specific and checkable term.

mentions.claim_text: He says that for some people the manifestation they have been praying over will come as easily as picking low-hanging fruit in an orchard, after long pressure and resistance.
mentions.quote: it will be like picking ripe cherries off a tree
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an encouragement to an unnamed audience with no measure.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether viewers sense revival in America and around the world, and says he speaks to few people and feels he is on the back side of the desert with his family.
mentions.quote: I feel like I'm on the back side of the desert
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a personal reflection.

mentions.claim_text: He says his wife told him they have people from Australia, Canada and England praying together at the same time within the hour, and calls it an army worldwide at the touch of a button.
mentions.quote: an army worldwide within just a touch of a button
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: a description of the channel's current audience, which is measurable against live viewer counts.

mentions.claim_text: Citing the humbling condition, he reports the Lord asking what they will do with the window of opportunity right now, and points to elections going liberal in South Korea.
mentions.quote: Brandon, I'm giving you a window. What will you do with this window
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: the window has no stated start or end.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim. The South Korean election he cites had already happened, on 3 June 2025.

mentions.claim_text: Speaking prophetically in the first person, he says they will consider destroying the United States and will not, because of the saints, and that suddenly North Korea shall rise up.
mentions.quote: For suddenly North Korea shall rise up
mentions.falsify_match: A sudden North Korean move against the United States.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Suddenly carries no date. This is the third distinct North Korea claim in ten weeks and the second that contradicts the Jonathan and David one.

mentions.claim_text: He says it concerns North Korea and Iran again, that he was being shown a major revival, and notes that they hear in part and see in part.
mentions.quote: we hear in part and we see in part
mentions.falsify_match: Revival in North Korea and Iran.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The in-part clause is his standard hedge and is doing its usual work here.

mentions.claim_text: He says he cannot be convinced they are not in the last of the last days, and that they are about to see a peace agreement struck with Israel and the negotiation for the third temple.
mentions.quote: We're about to see a peace agreement struck with Israel
mentions.falsify_match: A peace agreement with Israel opening third temple negotiations.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. About to has no date.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are thinking about what happens after the next three and a half years, recalls the handful of cards, and says Putin wants all of Ukraine and all of Poland in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: he wants all of Ukraine and he wants all of Poland
mentions.falsify_match: Russia moving to take all of Ukraine and then Poland.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Poland is a NATO member, which makes this the most consequential single element in the war thread.

mentions.claim_text: He says western influence was shrinking, that he saw Canada in desperate need in the days ahead, a great financial crash and crisis coming to certain sectors of Canada that they will not be able to sustain, and people trying to leave Canada.
mentions.quote: I saw a great financial crash crisis coming to certain sectors of Canada
mentions.falsify_match: A sectoral financial crisis in Canada severe enough to drive emigration.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Sectors are unnamed, which is the loose part.
